# Start Scaling Player

Source: [wiki article 9662](../archive/9662.md); edited 2026-09-05.

Exact pinned API: [Start Scaling Player](../../api/actions/start-scaling-player.md).

<a id="wiki-9662-n1"></a>

- Player scaling changes movement collision, hit detection and certain abilities as well as appearance.

<a id="wiki-9662-n2"></a>

- Large players in complex environments can severely increase server load; article suggests disabling environment movement collision.

<a id="wiki-9662-n3"></a>

- Scale is a multiplier, sampled every frame only when reevaluation is enabled.
